caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a puppet or doll with a stylized human form. The figure is wearing a long-sleeved garment and pants that have a geometric zigzag pattern in shades of red, yellow, white, pink, and green. The sleeves of the garment are puffy. The puppet’s hands are gray, and the left hand is in a relaxed position while the right is partially closed. The figure has black shoes, one of which is attached to the body while the other appears to be loose or misaligned. There is a black belt or sash wrapped around the waist. The face of the puppet is detailed with grey skin, dark eyebrows, blue eyes, a thin black mustache, and prominent black hair styled upward with a curving peak. The cheeks have red heart-shaped spots, and the lips are outlined in red. The overall composition centers the puppet vertically against a plain, off-white background. The artist's name "HILDA OLSON" is written in small letters at the bottom right of the image.
title: Puppet
